verdict.rationale: Secureframe has built-in AI features (Comply AI), so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can consume external MCP servers. The axis therefore applies. The evidence only documents Secureframe publishing its own MCP server, which exposes Secureframe data to outside agents. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Secureframe connecting to or using third-party MCP servers' tools.
